name: dropped_third_tag_home_from_second
description: Runner on second only, one out. Uncaught third strike; the batter reaches first and the runner from second tries for home and is retired 2-1. First base was empty, so nothing behind the runner was occupied and the out is a TAG -- the same putout sequence, the same base, the same uncaught third strike as the motivating play, and the opposite answer.

source.note: Defeats a force chain that ignores whether the bases behind the runner are occupied. Required by spec/07-TESTING.md 2.2.
source.status: CONSTRUCTED -- not observed. The event string and the derivation are the assertion; no game is claimed. To be replaced when a real instance is located.

notes: The batter-runner is live, so first base is forced -- but there is no runner on first to force, and the runner on second has an empty base behind him. forced_bases({2}, live) is {1}, and the runner from second is not in it.
BatterReachedOnK fires here and not in strikeout_tag_home_2000: the difference is whether first base was occupied, which is what the rulebook keys the uncaught-third-strike rule on.
